title: Decomposition of Functions into Outer and Inner Components
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Express the function h(x) = (x^2 - 1)^4 as a composition of an outer function f(u) and an inner function g(x), so that h(x) = f(g(x)).

steps.title: Identify the Inner Sub-expression
steps.explanation: Look for the innermost operation acting directly on the independent variable x. The quantity inside the parentheses is the polynomial x^2 - 1.
steps.why: Functional decomposition identifies intermediate variables to simplify multi-step algebraic structures.

steps.title: Define the Outer Function
steps.explanation: Let u = g(x) = x^2 - 1. The outermost operation performed on this intermediate quantity is raising it to the fourth power, producing f(u) = u^4.
steps.why: The outer function represents the final operation in the sequential calculation.

steps.title: Verify by Composition
steps.explanation: Evaluating f at g(x) recreates the original composite function h(x), confirming the decomposition is mathematically valid.
steps.why: Composition verification confirms that f(g(x)) is identical to h(x).
